title: International SEO Guide for Wellness Brands
excerpt: Learn how to implement an effective international SEO strategy for health and wellness brands looking to expand their global reach.
description: Learn how to implement an effective international SEO strategy for health and wellness brands looking to expand their global reach.
html:
Introduction

Many health and wellness companies want to expand their reach beyond domestic borders in today's interconnected world. However, succeeding in international markets requires more than translating your content into multiple languages. An effective international SEO strategy is crucial for health and wellness brands hoping to rank highly and attract patients and customers worldwide.

With the right SEO approach, your health and wellness business can gain greater visibility and tap into new global opportunities.

Best Practices for International SEO Success

  • Conduct keyword research focused on your target countries and languages. Identify terms commonly used by people searching for your services globally. Also research keywords in the native languages of your priority markets.
  • Optimize website architecture using ccTLDs (country-code top-level domains) and subdomains to geotarget important countries. For example, create es.yourbrand.com for Spain or cn.yourbrand.com for China.
  • Create localized content optimized for individual markets. Translate or rewrite product descriptions, blog posts, and other content into the native languages of your target countries. Avoid direct word-for-word translations.
  • Adjust page titles and meta descriptions for each localized page or site version to include relevant keywords and convey what the page is about.
  • Get local phone numbers and addresses. List these prominently on each localized site or page to build trust with international audiences.
  • Earn backlinks from country-specific domains by getting featured on health portals, wellness directories, and niche sites popular in your target countries.
  • Verify and optimize local business listings on search engines and platforms like Google My Business. This helps you rank for searches by location.
  • Run PPC ads tailored to different countries and languages. Geo-target your campaigns and test translated ad copy.
  • Track analytics by country to see which markets drive the most traffic and conversions. Double down on high-performing areas.

Expanding into Emerging Markets

With large populations increasingly going online, emerging markets across Asia, South America, and Africa represent excellent opportunities for international expansion. Health and wellness businesses can tap lucrative new markets overseas by honing their global SEO approach.

FAQs

Q1. What are some tips for doing keyword research for international SEO?

‍A1. Look at Google Trends and keyword tools to identify popular search terms in your target countries. Also search directly on international Google sites for keyword ideas. Leverage tools like UberSuggest and AnswerThePublic for country-specific suggestions.

Q2. Should I get my site translated by professionals for international SEO?

‍A2. Yes, it's highly recommended. Machine translations often result in unnatural, inaccurate text. Hiring native translators and writers will produce better-quality localized content.

Q3. How can I learn about the SEO strategies of my foreign competitors?

‍A3. Use tools like SEMrush and Ahrefs to research which keywords your competitors rank for in their respective countries. Study their on-page optimization and backlink profiles for tactical insights.

Q4. How often should I update translated content for international SEO?

‍A4. Translate or rewrite new blog posts and other content monthly at a minimum. Stale, outdated text can negatively impact rankings and visitor engagement.

Q5. Is having separate URLs for each country or different versions on one domain is better?

‍A5. Generally, separate URLs are optimal for localization. It allows you to target individual markets better while showing international users the most relevant content.

Conclusion

Health and wellness brands can expand their global presence by implementing an informed international SEO strategy tailored to different markets. Partnering with an experienced international SEO agency provides the expertise and insights needed to rank highly and attract patients and customers worldwide. Focus on optimizing for local search behaviors and building trust across borders. With persistence and the right approach, the opportunities are endless, regardless of your customers' language.
